newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks slip into close, losses may continue.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks slip into close, losses may continue.

text.p: Madrid stocks slipped lower in late trade on Monday in what traders saw as an extension of the correction started last week. Dealers said there could be further losses in the short term.
The General index slipped to close 5.96 points, 1.28 percent, down at 458.20. The Ibex-35 index of leading shares falls 70.82 points, 1.33 percent, to 5,253.86.

"The market is continuing the correction sparked last week, but the direction in the medium term remains upward and at slightly lower prices, we could see new money coming into the market," said one trader.
Traders said Wall Street's close would dictate the direction for the market on Tuesday.
Among individual stocks, Telefonica was one of the worst performers, losing 75 pesetas, or 2.25 percent, to 3,240. Repsol closed unchanged at 5,880.
In the electricity sector, Endesa fell 2.9 percent, while Iberdrola lost 2.15 percent and Fecsa, 3.08 percent.
In the banking sector, Popular lost 2.3 percent, while other major banks fell less than one percent.
